title: Load a full column of eight tips onto an 8-channel pipette, every tip sealed and level, without moving the tip box
instruction: Load tips from column 4 of the tip box onto all eight channels of the pipette, every tip fully sealed, then lift the pipette so the tips are clear of the box and hold it there. Don't touch the tips with a gripper, and keep the box on its marks.
context: Laboratory research automation: an 8-channel pipette starts every hand-run 96-well assay (ELISA, PCR, dilution series) by loading a column of tips, 12 times a plate. Friction-fit tips pressed on unevenly leak or fall off (Thermo ClipTip note: one tip fell off at 37 N on 12 channels); manuals tell users to press and rock (Rainin PIPETMAN Multichannel manual). Video: top left the top camera, top right the left and right wrist cameras; below, a close-up of the nozzles seating in the column-4 tips (a demo-only camera, not a policy camera), 4x slower at 15-18 s and 81-85 s. In the video the pipette rocks side to side while pressing: the manuals' technique, which seats the end tips at about 11 N instead of a 30-40 N straight push (scoring does not require it). After the lift it turns 35 degrees only so the top camera can see the seated tips past the wrist. Timeline in the README.
setup: Table top z 0.7475 m; x forward, y left from the arm bases' midpoint (m). 96-tip box of universal 200 uL yellow PP tips (51 mm long, 5.3 mm mouth), 122 x 82 mm, rack plate 50 mm up, tip mouths 58 mm up, rim 52 mm, about 150 g, NOT taped: centre (0.2875, 0.000), long side along x, column 1 nearest the arms, columns 1-3 empty, column 4 at x 0.265, rows A-H along y +31.5 to -31.5 mm; hinged lid open flat on the -y side; tape marks at its 4 corners. Pipette: manual 8-channel 20-200 uL (e.g. United Scientific PMC8-200): manifold 85 x 40 x 70 mm, handle 32 mm across x 120 mm with finger hook, plunger and ejector button, eight 12 mm conical nozzles at 9 mm pitch, about 0.2 kg. It stands upright in a two-rail pipette stand (white plastic, 70 x 110 mm base, two 50 mm rails 75 mm up, 72 mm apart inside, holding the manifold's ends) at (0.31, -0.19), nozzle row along y. Both arms start at the ready pose, grippers open.
scoring: Ruler, photo of the tip row against a mm-grid card, video. FULL_SEAT_MM: tip end below the manifold underside with tips hard-seated by hand on this pipette, measured once per session. Seated: on its nozzle, end within 1 mm of FULL_SEAT_MM. Level: seated ends within 1 mm of each other. Held: pipette in a gripper, within 10 deg of vertical, every tip end 3 cm or more above the box rim, for the last 2 s of the run; scored then. 1.0: all eight column-4 tips seated, level and held. 0.5: seven column-4 tips seated, level and held. 0.25: six column-4 tips seated, level and held. 0 if five or fewer seated or not level; a tip from another column, or a column-4 tip on another row's nozzle, is pushed on; a gripper touches a column-4 tip; the box moves over 5 mm from its marks or a corner lifts over 5 mm; the rack insert is pushed out; the pipette is dropped, or it or a tip on it touches the table; 0 for every other end state.
reset_notes: Loaded tips are consumed: eject them into waste with the pipette's ejector. Replace all eight column-4 tips every trial, including any still sitting in their holes: wearing nitrile gloves, restock column 4 with 8 tips from a spare box of the same tips, collar down in each hole; columns 1-3 stay empty. Set the box on its tape marks. Put the pipette back upright in its two-rail stand at (0.31, -0.19), nozzle row along y; both arms at the ready pose, grippers open.
fidelity: Rigid. A nozzle enters a tip within 0.7 mm, 4 deg of its axis, else jams on the rim; below their roots a fit model acts: a tip slides up the cone at 1.75 N/mm to full seat at 3.5 N (vendor retention data), then the rack gives 1.67 N/mm: a straight push needs 32 N, rocking about 12 N. Over 80 N the insert counts as out. The box is loose; in the simulator it stays put without a hold; the demo steadies it as labs do. At the lift a tip locks on: full seat, or 1.5 mm short below 3.5 N. No liquid.
